headline.hi: 0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90° — Ek Baar Yaad Kiya, Zindagi Bhar Kaam Aayega!
headline.en: 0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90° — Learn It Once, Use It Forever!

subtext.hi: CBSE exams mein ye table sabse zyada use hoti hai — isko yaad karne ka ek simple trick hai.
subtext.en: This table is used the most in CBSE exams — there's a simple trick to remember it.

text.hi: Ye 5 angles (0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°) real life aur exams mein sabse zyada aate hain — inki values exact hoti hain, koi calculator nahi chahiye! 30° aur 60° equilateral triangle se derive hote hain, 45° isosceles right-angled triangle se, aur 0°/90° boundary (extreme) cases hain.
text.en: These 5 angles (0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°) come up most often in real life and exams — their values are exact, no calculator needed! 30° and 60° are derived from an equilateral triangle, 45° from an isosceles right-angled triangle, and 0°/90° are the boundary (extreme) cases.

content.hi: Table yaad karne ka super trick: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 likho (in 5 angles ke liye), sabko 4 se divide karo (0, 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 4/4), aur square root le lo — 0, 1/2, 1/√2, √3/2, 1. Ye mil gayi sin θ ki values! cos θ ke liye same values ulta (reverse) likh do, aur tan θ = sin θ/cos θ.
content.en: Super trick to remember the table: write 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 (for these 5 angles), divide all by 4 (0, 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 4/4), and take the square root — 0, 1/2, 1/√2, √3/2, 1. That's the sin θ values! For cos θ, write the same values in reverse, and tan θ = sin θ/cos θ.

content.hi: cosec, sec, cot ke liye bas reciprocal le lo: cosec θ = 1/sin θ, sec θ = 1/cos θ, cot θ = 1/tan θ. Dhyan rakho — cosec 0° aur sec 90° undefined hain (kyunki 1/0 = ∞).
content.en: For cosec, sec, cot, just take the reciprocal: cosec θ = 1/sin θ, sec θ = 1/cos θ, cot θ = 1/tan θ. Note — cosec 0° and sec 90° are undefined (since 1/0 = ∞).

content.hi: Interesting pattern: sin 30° = cos 60° = 1/2, sin 60° = cos 30° = √3/2 — table mein sin aur cos ki values ek doosre se reverse order mein match karti hain.
content.en: Interesting pattern: sin 30° = cos 60° = 1/2, sin 60° = cos 30° = √3/2 — in the table, sin and cos values match each other in reverse order.

caption.hi: 0,1,2,3,4 → ÷4 → √ = sin values. cos ke liye ulta likh do!
caption.en: 0,1,2,3,4 → ÷4 → √ = sin values. Write them in reverse for cos!

problem.hi: sin 30° cos 45° + tan 60° ki value nikaalo.
problem.en: Find the value of: sin 30° cos 45° + tan 60°

steps.hi: Table se values daalo: sin 30° = 1/2, cos 45° = 1/√2, tan 60° = √3
steps.en: Substitute values from the table: sin 30° = 1/2, cos 45° = 1/√2, tan 60° = √3

problem.en: Find the value of (2 tan 30°) / (1 − tan² 30°)

steps.hi: Answer = √3 = tan 60° (ye tan 2A formula ka hi ek roop hai!)
steps.en: Answer = √3 = tan 60° (this is actually the tan 2A formula in action!)

problem.hi: Agar sin(A+B) = √3/2 aur cos(A−B) = √3/2 hai (jahan 0° < A+B ≤ 90°), toh A aur B nikaalo.
problem.en: If sin(A+B) = √3/2 and cos(A−B) = √3/2 (where 0° < A+B ≤ 90°), find A and B.

question.en: What is the value of sin 60°?

explanation.hi: Galat — actually cos 0°=1 aur sin 0°=0 hota hai.
sin30°=cos60° aur cos30°=sin60°, isliye dono brackets barabar hain — difference 0.
explanation.en: sin30°=cos60° and cos30°=sin60°, so both brackets are equal — the difference is 0.

notes.hi: cos values sin ka reverse hote hain
notes.en: cos values are the reverse of sin values

notes.hi: tan 90° aur cosec 0°/sec 90° undefined hote hain

summary.hi: Ab tumhe standard angles ki saari values yaad hain aur inhe expressions mein substitute kar sakte ho. Agle lesson mein hum seekhenge ratios ke beech relationships — ek ratio diya ho toh baaki kaise nikaalte hain.
summary.en: You now know all the standard angle values and can substitute them into expressions. Next, we'll learn the relationships between ratios — how to find the rest when only one ratio is given.
